description: On sign-in the console opens on 'nightly-builds' (first alphabetically) rather than the owner's main or most recently used drive. Deep links and remembered selection do not exist, so every return visit starts at the same arbitrary drive.
expected: Open the last-used drive (remember in localStorage) or the most recently active one.
actual: First drive in the list is selected every time.
suggested_fix: Persist selected drive id client-side and restore it on load.

description: The same 'drive key needed' state is shown by a chip, a Load drive key button and one disabled Download button per row. The reason for the disabled buttons is only in a hover title, invisible on touch devices.
expected: One clear prompt; disabled row buttons that explain themselves or are replaced with a single 'Load key to download' action.
actual: Five elements say the same thing; the per-row reason is tooltip only.
suggested_fix: Hide or merge the per-row disabled Downloads until a key is loaded, or make a click open the key loader.

description: The healthy 'Key backed up 11/6/2026 (file)' status uses a red/orange dot, the same colour used for warnings.
expected: Green or neutral dot for a satisfied state.
suggested_fix: Use a success colour for backed-up state.
